<mxfile host="draw.io"> <diagram name="Networking Architecture" id="networking"> <mxGraphModel dx="1400" dy="900" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="1600" pageHeight="1000" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0"/> <mxCell id="1" parent="0"/>
<!-- External clients --> <mxCell id="client" value="LAN Clients
(Browser)" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#fff2cc;strokeColor=#d6b656;fontStyle=1;fontSize=11;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="40" y="120" width="120" height="50" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <mxCell id="lb_pool" value="LoadBalancer IP Pool
CILIUM_LOADBALANCER_IPPOOL
(.208-.222)" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f8cecc;strokeColor=#b85450;fontStyle=1;fontSize=10;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="40" y="220" width="160" height="60" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <mxCell id="dns" value="DNS
*.k8s.local" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#fff2cc;strokeColor=#d6b656;fontSize=11;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="40" y="310" width="160" height="50" as="geometry"/> </mxCell>
<!-- K8s Cluster container --> <mxCell id="cluster" value="Kubernetes Cluster" style="swimlane;startSize=30;fillColor=#dae8fc;strokeColor=#6c8ebf;rounded=1;fontSize=13;fontStyle=1;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="240" y="100" width="700" height="680" as="geometry"/> </mxCell>
<!-- kube-system namespace --> <mxCell id="kubesys" value="kube-system" style="swimlane;startSize=22;fillColor=#e6e6e6;strokeColor=#999999;rounded=1;fontSize=11;fontStyle=1;" vertex="1" parent="cluster"> <mxGeometry x="20" y="40" width="320" height="200" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <mxCell id="cilium_agent" value="Cilium Agent
(DaemonSet)" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=10;" vertex="1" parent="kubesys"> <mxGeometry x="20" y="30" width="130" height="40" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <mxCell id="cilium_op" value="Cilium Operator" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=10;" vertex="1" parent="kubesys"> <mxGeometry x="170" y="30" width="130" height="40" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <mxCell id="cilium_ingress" value="Cilium Ingress
Controller" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=10;" vertex="1" parent="kubesys"> <mxGeometry x="20" y="85" width="130" height="40" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <mxCell id="hubble" value="Hubble Relay
+ UI" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=10;" vertex="1" parent="kubesys"> <mxGeometry x="170" y="85" width="130" height="40" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <mxCell id="coredns" value="CoreDNS
(rewrite *.k8s.local)" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=10;" vertex="1" parent="kubesys"> <mxGeometry x="20" y="145" width="130" height="40" as="geometry"/> </mxCell>
<!-- Encryption layer --> <mxCell id="wireguard" value="WireGuard Encryption
(node-to-node, transparent)" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=10;dashed=1;" vertex="1" parent="cluster"> <mxGeometry x="380" y="60" width="200" height="40" as="geometry"/> </mxCell>
<!-- L2 Announcement --> <mxCell id="l2" value="L2 Announcement
(ARP on worker nodes)" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=10;" vertex="1" parent="cluster"> <mxGeometry x="380" y="120" width="200" height="40" as="geometry"/> </mxCell>
<!-- Istio namespace (optional) --> <mxCell id="istio_ns" value="istio-system (optional)" style="swimlane;startSize=22;fillColor=#e6e6e6;strokeColor=#999999;rounded=1;fontSize=11;fontStyle=2;" vertex="1" parent="cluster"> <mxGeometry x="20" y="260" width="320" height="120" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <mxCell id="ztunnel" value="ztunnel
(DaemonSet)" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=10;" vertex="1" parent="istio_ns"> <mxGeometry x="20" y="30" width="130" height="40" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <mxCell id="istiod" value="istiod
(control plane)" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=10;" vertex="1" parent="istio_ns"> <mxGeometry x="170" y="30" width="130" height="40" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <mxCell id="istio_cni" value="Istio CNI
(DaemonSet)" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=10;" vertex="1" parent="istio_ns"> <mxGeometry x="20" y="75" width="130" height="35" as="geometry"/> </mxCell>
<!-- Ingress resources --> <mxCell id="ingress_box" value="Ingress Resources" style="swimlane;startSize=22;fillColor=#e6e6e6;strokeColor=#999999;rounded=1;fontSize=11;fontStyle=1;" vertex="1" parent="cluster"> <mxGeometry x="380" y="260" width="290" height="250" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <mxCell id="ing_argocd" value="argocd.k8s.local" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=10;" vertex="1" parent="ingress_box"> <mxGeometry x="20" y="30" width="120" height="28" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <mxCell id="ing_grafana" value="grafana.k8s.local" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=10;" vertex="1" parent="ingress_box"> <mxGeometry x="20" y="68" width="120" height="28" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <mxCell id="ing_keycloak" value="keycloak.k8s.local" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=10;" vertex="1" parent="ingress_box"> <mxGeometry x="20" y="106" width="120" height="28" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <mxCell id="ing_harbor" value="harbor.k8s.local" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=10;" vertex="1" parent="ingress_box"> <mxGeometry x="20" y="144" width="120" height="28" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <mxCell id="ing_hubble" value="hubble.k8s.local" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=10;" vertex="1" parent="ingress_box"> <mxGeometry x="20" y="182" width="120" height="28" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <mxCell id="ing_matrix" value="matrix.k8s.local" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=10;" vertex="1" parent="ingress_box"> <mxGeometry x="155" y="30" width="120" height="28" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <mxCell id="ing_thanos" value="thanos.k8s.local" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=10;" vertex="1" parent="ingress_box"> <mxGeometry x="155" y="68" width="120" height="28" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <mxCell id="ing_alert" value="alertmanager.k8s.local" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=10;" vertex="1" parent="ingress_box"> <mxGeometry x="155" y="106" width="120" height="28" as="geometry"/> </mxCell>
<!-- TLS --> <mxCell id="tls" value="cert-manager
TLS certificates" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f5f5f5;strokeColor=#666666;fontColor=#666666;fontSize=10;" vertex="1" parent="cluster"> <mxGeometry x="380" y="185" width="200" height="40" as="geometry"/> </mxCell>
<!-- Edges --> <mxCell id="e_client_lb" edge="1" source="client" target="lb_pool" parent="1" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;orthogonalLoop=1;jettySize=auto;html=1;exitX=0.5;exitY=1;exitDx=0;exitDy=0;entryX=0.5;entryY=0;entryDx=0;entryDy=0;"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e_client_lb_l" value="HTTPS" style="edgeLabel;html=1;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;resizable=0;points=[];fontSize=9;" vertex="1" connectable="0" parent="e_client_lb"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"><mxPoint as="offset"/></mxGeometry> </mxCell>
<mxCell id="e_lb_ingress" edge="1" source="lb_pool" target="cilium_ingress" parent="1" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;orthogonalLoop=1;jettySize=auto;html=1;exitX=1;exitY=0.5;exitDx=0;exitDy=0;entryX=0;entryY=0.5;entryDx=0;entryDy=0;"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e_lb_ingress_l" value="L2 ARP" style="edgeLabel;html=1;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;resizable=0;points=[];fontSize=9;" vertex="1" connectable="0" parent="e_lb_ingress"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"><mxPoint as="offset"/></mxGeometry> </mxCell>
<mxCell id="e_dns_coredns" edge="1" source="dns" target="coredns" parent="1" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;orthogonalLoop=1;jettySize=auto;html=1;dashed=1;exitX=1;exitY=0.5;exitDx=0;exitDy=0;entryX=0;entryY=0.5;entryDx=0;entryDy=0;"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e_dns_coredns_l" value="internal rewrite" style="edgeLabel;html=1;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;resizable=0;points=[];fontSize=9;" vertex="1" connectable="0" parent="e_dns_coredns"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"><mxPoint as="offset"/></mxGeometry> </mxCell>
</root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>
